snippet.title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Uprising | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Uprising is out now.
Take command of the Resistance in a massive rogue-like sandbox campaign across 22 dynamic sectors.
Battle Legion, outsmart rival factions, and shape the future of humanity.
Your strategy decides who survives.

🎮 Play now on Steam ➡️ http://steam.gs/l/2g4pe
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️ https://discord.gg/u3YY7tnU8D
